answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 231 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the jade log shows the live set and the bridge audit records each lapse. Keeping 100 aliases alive as a result means 100 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the violet quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
